remarks: Just a stone's throw from Abbot Kinney and blocks from Venice Beach, this beautifully renovated two bedroom, one bathroom gem captures the effortless charm of coastal living. Fully renovated in 2021, the home pairs contemporary finishes with an inviting layout, while smooth stucco, Ipe wood accents, and new tile give the exterior an understated elegance. Upstairs, this top floor residence enjoys leafy views of the neighborhood's lush greenery, custom California closets, additional extended kitchen storage with a custom breakfast banquette, creating a peaceful retreat in the heart of Venice.
